name: Tennessee Sheet Metal Inc
old_description: Tennessee Sheet Metal, Inc., is a company that believes in providing the greatest possible quality and service to its customers. Founded in 1951, on that principle, we have grown to become one of the largest sheet metal shops in the mid-state area, while retaining personalized service to our customers.
about:
Tennessee Sheet Metal, Inc. was founded in 1951 in Madison, Tennessee, a community just north of Nashville. The company began with a principle of providing the greatest possible quality and service to its customers, a philosophy that has guided its growth over seven decades.

Today the firm operates from a 45,000-square-foot facility where a team of sheet metal engineers and skilled craftsmen engineer, design, fabricate, and erect a range of products. Core offerings include stainless steel kitchen equipment, industrial and commercial sheet metal work, and complete air-conditioning, heating, and ventilating systems. Specific services cover air duct systems, dust collection systems, stainless steel fabrication and welding, custom applications, and exhaust systems. The shop runs equipment such as a plasma table, a Trimble Autobid system, a 10-ton crane, a Spiro pipe machine, and a duct coil line.

The company serves commercial construction, industrial manufacturing, HVAC, and food-service equipment sectors. Its customer base includes contractors and facility owners needing custom ductwork, kitchen exhaust hoods, dust collection networks, and specialized stainless steel assemblies for industrial plants.

Tennessee Sheet Metal emphasizes that its founding commitment to quality and personalized service remains intact despite becoming one of the largest sheet metal shops in the mid-state region. The company also highlights a 100 percent safety commitment and maintains affiliations with the International Training Institute, SMACNA, and SMART.
